inputs.description: 133 OMP_ALGO::nth_element cases over vectors of [key, tag] pairs compared on key alone: every (size, nth) pair for sizes 0..17, pseudo-random key streams with 1, 2, 3, 7 and 50 distinct keys at sizes 20/33/64/100/298/597, and sorted / reversed / organ-pipe / all-equal shapes at 597 (the real -aun deme size). Key streams come from an LCG hardcoded in the probe, so the fixture depends on no library RNG and no external dataset.
